name: folio
description: Personal portfolio manager: track holdings across brokers and currencies, see real performance, keep your allocation on target.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @folio/shared" "npm run dev -w @folio/api" "npm run dev -w @folio/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @folio/shared && npm run build -w @folio/api && npm run build -w @folio/web
